kind: Public source contract evidence for credential deduplication, missing-email refresh and import email-job observation
scope: Source inspection only. No private database/credential reads or business requests. No MGMT development. No in-flight credentials/api.ts read or hash.

response_200.total_count: integer: all credential states in selected mode
response_200.skipped_count: integer: records with truthy cached user_email

semantics: Synchronous loop; not a background job; no job_id or success:true envelope.

Cached truthy email produces success:true, skipped:true and does NOT increase success_count. Failed lookup yields success:false,user_email:null,error. Success without skip yields success:true,user_email:string.
Failed count may only be derived from validated consistent total-success-skipped; never use generic aggregate(success_count,total_count) which misclassifies skipped as failed.
No force/refetch option, selection body, filters, pagination or cancel-job contract. Abort stops client waiting, not proof of server rollback.
refresh_all_emails.support: Both modes through same common implementation; no auto_email capability gate here. Source support only, no live backend validation.

response_200.duplicate_groups: array of {email,kept_file,deleted_files:string[],duplicate_count:number}; count is actual successful deletions
response_200.delete_errors: array of strings, may contain raw exception text

semantics: Destructive whole selected-channel operation. No preview/dry_run/selected filenames/force parameter. Caller must obtain explicit confirmation before one POST; never automatically replay after unknown outcome.

SQLite/Postgres/MySQL/Mongo implementations group exact stored truthy email values, order filename ascending, keep first filename, remove later names. No lowercase/trim normalization in this operation; no-email credentials retained.

HTTP200 may contain delete_errors with successful deletions: partial outcome, not unconditional success. Zero duplicates returns full zero-deletion envelope. Outer operation error may return HTTP500 with only zero counters/message.

Backend duplicate lookup catches storage exceptions and returns empty zero aggregates; client cannot prove an empty result reflects an actual empty store. Record this existing limitation; do not invent health success.
No job_id; unrelated to import email-enrichment jobs.
deduplicate_by_email.support: Both modes; all four inspected storage implementations support mode. Runtime/storage availability not probed.

response_200.total: number of tracked items, excludes omitted
response_200.items: array of {filename,status,reason}; user_email only when status=success

semantics: Process-local AG import receipt jobs only, never historical credential scans. Completion requires sealed, no pending imports, no active queued/running/settlement_pending items.
Receipts from AG import/OAuth may contain email_enrichment {job_id,accepted,skipped,status_url}; job_id can be null. Do not invent jobs from filenames/list annotations/status_url.
Native single-worker and supported backend prerequisites govern auto_email capability and admission. GCLI import creates no jobs; existing frontend explicitly rejects GCLI readEmailJob/readEmailJobs.
No list-all-jobs, stop-server-job or refresh-all-as-job endpoint. Status annotations on credential list carry status/reason, not recoverable job IDs.

selected_copy_emails.semantics: Already persisted email values only; never upstream lookup. Trims email and deduplicates case-insensitively for copying. Does not delete credentials. Distinct from deduplicate-by-email.

existing_frontend.import_api: createImportApi(context).readEmailJob and top-level readEmailJobs(jobIds,signal,context) already exist. Reuse readEmailJobs for current owner's genuine AG import receipt IDs only.
existing_frontend.readEmailJobs: Copies scope/mode, lowercase32hex IDs, deduplicates <=128, <=4 concurrent reads, order-preserving observed/expired/unavailable results;404 expired; abort/stale rejects collection and stops unsent work. No polling/timers/store/mutation.
existing_frontend.readEmailJob: Existing paged reader limit100/max50/max5000, validates total/job identity/states/unique filenames, requires complete+sealed and terminal rows. Existing broader single-job ID signature is compatibility; multi-reader strictly uses receipt IDs.
existing_frontend.current_import_ui: hooks.ts currently uses one jobId and readEmailJob with ~2s polling. Effect cleanup aborts on unmount; no cross-page multi-job restoration proven. Do not duplicate reader to solve lifecycle.
existing_frontend.current_credentials_ui: index.tsx imports legacy api and calls api.emails(selectedNames) for selected copy, api.download for selected ZIP, api.action and quotaBatch. Selected email copying exists; manual clipboard fallback/native mode binding remain separate work.
existing_frontend.baseline_api_boundary: Prior inspected stable credential API baseline SHA b1a63fc129891b045ef434b7c75024ee1adc2edadee82295a0e24688031fa503 had no refresh-all-emails or deduplicate-by-email adapters. R139 metadata adds readContent/fetchEmail only and preserves existing downloadOne/downloadAll/emails/actions. This is historical evidence, NOT a fresh snapshot of the currently writing file; re-read after delivery before freezing a future request.

safety_projection: Future adapters should allowlist own typed metadata, validate finite nonnegative integer counters and consistency, preserve partial/unknown outcomes, drop raw message/error/delete_errors strings (safe error counts/categories can be projected), and never log/store full response or arbitrary errors. Missing/invalid must not be fabricated as zero.

baseline_metadata.note: R139 planning metadata, not in-flight API source
